_: THE single source of truth for every agent. ONE flat list, one row per agent, one line each. The Agent Invocation Gate reads this first on every /agent-name (gates/agent-invocation-gate.md STEP 0). Renderer: roster.html. Deep detail is NEVER stored here — it lives in the agent's own files (super-agents/<slug>/ or agents/<slug>.md) and in git history. registry.json is RETIRED as of 2026-07-25; this file replaced it.
schema: slug | name | class(super-agent|agent|task-specific|retired) | memory(true=holds context across sessions) | status | invoke | aka[] | seat | teams[] | lane(ONE line) | home | from(lineage pointer) | accent
class_note: class = PERSISTENCE, never rank (super-agent-base.md Constitution §6). 'super-agent' = seated persona with a memory bundle. 'agent' = stateless lens. Mira seats by LANE, never by class. An agent upgrades to super-agent for exactly one reason: it needs MEMORY — and that upgrade is a ONE-FIELD edit here, which is why the list is never split by class.
slim_rule: KEEP THIS FILE UNDER ~12KB. Lane is one line. No migration prose, no changelog, no full role text — those belong in the agent's own files + git. A file that can't be read whole can't be safely edited, and this file IS the registration path.
